label: Get set up
blurb: Bring what you already have into Supernova, then let the agent build the structure.

label: Audit what you have
blurb: See what is inconsistent, missing or drifting before you change anything.

label: Maintain at scale
blurb: One prompt, every page. The work that used to take a list and a week.

label: Create and reuse
blurb: Start from a page you already trust instead of a blank one.

label: Measure and improve
blurb: Know what changed, who uses the system and what to fix next.
